feedback: You have a good foundation to build on, but it's essential to work on clearly expressing your thoughts and experiences. better_answer_example: As an entry-level IT student, I'm excited about the opportunity to work as a software engineer. One of my notable projects was a learning portal I developed with a friend, focusing on education. My role involved designing and implementing key features, which taught me a lot about teamwork and problem-solving. Although I faced some challenges in understanding the requirements, I was able to overcome them by discussing with my team and refining my approach. This experience not only deepened my understanding of Node.js and Python but also showed me the importance of clear communication in a development team. I believe my passion for computer science, combined with my practical experience and eagerness to learn, makes me a strong candidate for this position.
